text:
Asha V.: Hi all, first week here. Quick security questions: 1) My corp laptop is stuck in shipping, can I use personal Mac for now? 2) I got the phishing sim notice 1 do I need to do anything immediately? 3) How do I prove disk encryption when I file the BYOD ticket?

Mira (People Ops): Welcome Asha! :wave: Short answers: personal Mac OK temporarily if you enroll in MDM and enable FileVault. Phish sim is mandatory but it runs later in week 2 for most new hires  no action right now besides reading the email. For BYOD proof, paste the `fdesetup status` output into the ticket.

IT Helpdesk: @Asha V.  If you choose BYOD, follow the BYOD checklist: https://redwood.infra/byod. To check FileVault: run `fdesetup status`. If FileVault is Off, run `sudo /opt/redwood/enroll_device.sh --mdm` or open a loaner request. Loaners are limited but we can provision for new hires.

Asha V.: Thanks. One follow-up: can I use desktop Authy for MFA rather than phone? Also the phish sim email had a suspicious-looking attachment  should I forward that to someone now?

Security Team: Desktop Authy is fine on a personal machine. For attachments in suspicious emails, do not open them. Use the built-in "Report Phish" button in your mail client or forward to phishing@redwood.infra. If you already opened something, DM Security immediately with the message and any URLs.

Mira (People Ops): I'll create a BYOD ticket for you and mark "new-hire" priority so IT can follow up quickly. Onboard Bot: Security quiz reminder set (due in 6 days). Phishing sim window for new hires: 1766070000 - 1766156400.
